scope: All new main branches: original-evidence authentication, successful-stage reuse, isolated package view, state-byte reuse, current resource gates and failure retention.
The single corrected relative-LEAN_PATH delta and compressed bootstrap/request-template binding.
No repeated mathematical audit of unchanged helpers, no old import graph parsing, no producer execution or remote task.

findings.detail: New main verifies project and .lake are not symlinks, verifies the existing packages final component is a symlink to the exact old goldbach-p2 package directory, creates a previously absent owned 10-package view, then unlinks only that owned final symlink and links it to the new view. It never writes into any old target package directory. mathlib resolves to /workspace/compile-deps/mathlib with exact original Git rev; all other nine paths are retained.
findings.LeanArchitect_scope: Its old path and manifest pin are retained without asserting that the nine-package preflight covered its Git checkout.

findings.detail: Before any new write, the controller binds original actual request/terminal/job/stdout/fresh-observation bytes, checks the pinned failed evidence and expected stage list, reads stable original process/log/state files, checks exact commands/cwd/exits/log SHA and guard-log byte slices, validates the initial audit prefix and pinned version/prefix outputs, and matches the entire AlmostPrime failed import log. Only the three genuinely successful stages are listed as reused; omitted-direct-imports remains failed and is the stage to retry. No setup or those three stages is invoked again.

The new state file copies the original bytes without changing environment, guard state environment path, lock/slot, log or shadow paths. Original run_guarded.py reads the specified state and applies its unchanged environment; original ci_runtime_guard.audit writes audit.json beside the explicitly supplied new state path. Therefore the final audit output is separate while wrappers append to the original log. The original audit, state, setup/process logs and other original runtime files are protected; the old log prefix is preserved and rechecked, while only append is permitted for that log.
findings.tools_read_from: p29-current/unit-tail-qualified/original-tools, checked against the exact unchanged contract pins

findings.original_problem: Superseded 4ab095 interpreted relative LEAN_PATH entries in the controller cwd instead of the stage cwd=root. Root identified this before execution.
findings.fixed_behavior: Each raw LEAN_PATH entry remains absolute if already absolute; otherwise it is interpreted as root / entry, matching stage cwd. The first-prefix selection checks that interpreted list. Raw strings, stage cwd, interpreted absolute paths and selected resolved paths are all retained. Empty entries still fail; no fallback or skipped namespace was introduced.

findings.detail: The unchanged current resources() gate is called before new out creation and again before the first new guarded command, with the cgroup binding required stable. Visible cgroup hierarchy or explicitly classified service-sampled-RSS/unexposed mode is preserved. Host availability is not asserted to be a per-task hard cgroup guarantee. Submission-time observation and actual MCP requested limits still require the later actual request/get_task join. Required fields use explicit access/assertions; unavailable foreign dependency fields keep the original sentinel and are joined to authenticated source imports and original qualified object pins rather than interpreted as empty.

A new guarded lake env path observation checks first providers before the still-required actual compiled-header/facet probe. The new target normal cannot run before expected-origin and full current-input matching succeed. All old normal/kernel/owned suppliers are reused. Existing output directory stops repeated submission; any failed gate raises, retains the newly created failure evidence and partial target outputs, and never retries automatically.
